description: This Java class implements an ExternalEventSourceProvider that provides a set of ExternalEventSourceData sources. It encapsulates a collection of source data and returns it via the provide() method.

classes.name: SimpleExternalEventSourceProvider
classes.description: Implements ExternalEventSourceProvider; maintains a set of ExternalEventSourceData objects and provides them via the provide() method.

methods.name: SimpleExternalEventSourceProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the sourcePackages set with an immutable copy of the provided collection.

methods.name: provide
methods.description: Returns the set of ExternalEventSourceData sources.
